title: Angles as Turns
lesson: Start by identifying what is known and what must be found in the situations from ‘Angles as Turns’. Explore turns and rotation, then connect it to quarter turn and half turn. Before accepting an answer, estimate or reason about its size, then explain why the method is valid.
